title: neomolina gracilis
intro: Neomolina gracilis, commonly known as the "Wild Yam," is a plant native to Central and South America. The health benefits of Neomolina gracilis include its potential to support women's reproductive health, alleviate menstrual cramps, and provide anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax muscles, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of Neomolina gracilis include diosgenin, a steroidal saponin with estrogenic and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
